goal: Add a GitHub Actions workflow that runs lint + typecheck + test + build on every push and PR. Cache node_modules. Single OS (ubuntu-latest), Node 22 LTS.
constraints: Steps run sequentially: install -> lint -> typecheck -> test -> build.
PR template asks for: summary, screenshots if UI, test plan, ADR link if architectural.
CODEOWNERS sets root owner to the repo owner (placeholder login `@owner`).
Do not add any external action besides @v4 ones above.
acceptance: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` is valid YAML and references only the constrained actions.
PR template is non-trivial: at least 4 sections.
CODEOWNERS has at least one entry.
